# Decrypt through the unlock agent: the PIN is entered once, at unlock.
[!exec:sleep] skip
env AGE_PLUGIN_TPM_AGENT_SOCK=$SOCKDIR/s/agent.sock
env AGE_TPM_PIN=1234
exec age-plugin-tpm --generate --pin -o identity.txt
exec age-plugin-tpm -y identity.txt -o recipient.txt
stdin input.txt
exec age -R recipient.txt -o secret.age

exec age-plugin-tpm --agent &agent&
exec sleep 1
exec age-plugin-tpm --agent-status
stdout '0 identities unlocked'
exec age-plugin-tpm --unlock identity.txt
exec age-plugin-tpm --agent-status
stdout '1 identities unlocked'

# No PIN in the environment: the agent supplies the authorization.
env AGE_TPM_PIN=
stdin secret.age
exec age -d -i identity.txt
stdout 'Hello World'

exec age-plugin-tpm --lock
exec age-plugin-tpm --agent-status
stdout '0 identities unlocked'

# Without the agent the plugin uses the TPM directly.
env AGE_PLUGIN_NO_AGENT=1
env AGE_TPM_PIN=1234
stdin secret.age
exec age -d -i identity.txt
stdout 'Hello World'

kill -INT agent
wait agent
! exists $SOCKDIR/s/agent.sock

-- input.txt --
Hello World
